paragraphs: R' Aivu bar Nagri, Rosh Hashanah 21a; Dikdukei Soferim reads bar Nagra.
R' Mashin bar Nagri; Bereshit Rabbah 82:4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim; וגרסת introduces the attributed reading bar-Nagra and is not itself a variant word. No fresh collation is claimed.

כא. gives Rosh Hashanah 21a under the period convention. ב״ר פפ״ב־ד is read as Bereshit Rabbah 82:4, retaining the exact anomalous Hebrew label here; no named edition or print check resolves it. Nagri/Nagra and the separate Mashin attestation remain distinct, with both personal titles R'.
